name: Promarksvac Corp. - Industrial Food Vacuum Packaging Machine & Commercial Meat Processing Equipment
old_description: Manufacturer of Vacuum Packaging Machine for the Food & Non-Food Industry
about:
Promarksvac Corp. was founded in 1989 in Ontario, California, as a California corporation. The company operates as the parent of Foodmax, Profood, and the Promarks Heat Seal Division, with manufacturing facilities in the United States and Taiwan. The U.S. headquarters handles sales and distribution for North and South America, while the Taiwan facility serves the Pacific Rim and other international markets.

The company manufactures a range of vacuum packaging machines, including tabletop, single-chamber, double-chamber, belt-type, and nozzle-type models, as well as rollstock and MAP tray sealing systems. Its food processing equipment line covers brine injectors, vacuum tumblers and massagers, shrink tanks, mixers, and hydraulic piston stuffers. Promarksvac also builds custom machinery, such as high-vacuum laminating systems and 300-inch heat sealers, and integrates PLC/HMI controls and temperature-controlled sealing on many models. Selected systems use Busch vacuum pumps and carry UL, ETL, or NSF certifications.

Promarksvac serves the food industry — meat, poultry, seafood, cheese, and ready-to-eat meals — as well as non-food and medical packaging applications. Customers range from butcher shops, delis, and restaurants to large-scale production plants. The equipment is designed for both small production spaces and high-volume lines.

The company emphasizes innovation, durable construction, and long-term technical support. Its stated mission is to provide competitively priced packaging and processing solutions with ongoing equipment innovation and customer satisfaction, aiming to enhance productivity and profitability for its partners.
